APPROVE
The moved logic matches the original (same checks, same order, same messages, same cache writes and log lines), and by my count the method drops to 15 (25 increments removed, 8 added). I couldn't build it because the source isn't on this machine, so the build depends on `merged` being an `IReadOnlyList<ShellVerdict>` and `gateLog` being a `List<string>` as the new signatures assume.
